payout_quote: Official Sniffspot Help Center 'How much does Sniffspot charge hosts?': 'Sniffspot does not charge any up-front or monthly hosting fees.' Also: 'Instead, Sniffspot deducts fees from host earnings.' 'For most US bookings, the total fees include: 22% Sniffspot fee.' 'Hosts keep the remaining earnings from each booking.' And: 'Hosts have complete control over their pricing and availability.'
steps: Create a host profile on sniffspot.com and describe your yard/land.
Add 10+ photos, set your availability calendar and hourly price per dog.
Get approved and accept guest bookings for private off-leash dog visits.
Receive monthly payout of remaining earnings after the 22% Sniffspot fee and payment processing.
catches: Sniffspot deducts a 22% platform fee plus ~2.37% + $0.22 per-charge payment processing from each booking; earnings are a share of guest payments, not a guaranteed amount.
Requires a suitable yard/land; earnings depend entirely on location, demand, and pricing.
International payouts incur extra Stripe fees ($2.25 + 0.25%); all pricing is in USD.
You need a private, safe space guests actually want to book — apartments without yards cannot participate.
biggest_catch: You need a bookable private yard/land and there is no guaranteed income: hosts set their own prices but keep only ~75% of each booking after the 22% fee and processing, and earnings depend entirely on local demand.
eligibility: Anyone with a suitable private yard or land; guests' dogs must be vaccinated.
timing: Listing setup takes under an hour; hosts are paid via monthly payouts after each booking's fees are deducted.
